description: Known answer for the content.diagnostic input_digest of the TypeScript loader through loka play (ADR-075 §3: SHA-256 of the artifact file's bytes, never the content hash): artifact is the file's text (its UTF-8 bytes, final newline included, are the input; it fails with UNKNOWN_FORMAT) and sha256 was computed by Python hashlib.sha256 over those bytes, never by the kernels.
